guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.278 to 18.47 (+6545%, z=+589) and its latency-90 and latency-50 rose with it (z=+82 and +58), while no other service shows a comparable shift (memory +13.7% and socket +2.9% are minor). Logs have no warnings or errors and the traces have no error spans, so the CPU saturation is the only strong anomaly. The slowest traces run through currencyservice and productcatalogservice and do not clearly implicate emailservice, but the metric evidence still points to it.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for a runaway process or hot loop, raise its CPU limits or add replicas to relieve the saturation, and restart the pod only if the CPU stays pegged.
